headline: President Prabowo Subianto Convenes Ten Former Police Chiefs
seoTitle: President Prabowo Meets Ten Former Police Chiefs
metaDescription: President Prabowo Subianto met with ten former heads of the Indonesian National Police at his residence in Hambalang to discuss current national issues.
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto held a meeting with ten former Chiefs of the Indonesian National Police (Kapolri) in Hambalang.
The session, which included current Police Chief General Suyudi Ario Seto, focused on exchanging perspectives regarding recent developments in the country.
While the specific details of the discussion were not disclosed, reports confirmed the attendance of various former leaders, excluding former chief Idham Azis.
aiContextParagraph: On November 8, 2026, Indonesian President Prabowo Subianto hosted a gathering with ten former Chiefs of the Indonesian National Police at his private residence in Hambalang, Bogor, West Java. The event served as a platform for the president to engage with retired police leadership to discuss ongoing national issues and foster dialogue between prominent figures. The current Chief of the Indonesian National Police, General Suyudi Ario Seto, accompanied the president during the proceedings. Media accounts highlighted the attendance of notable figures such as Tito Karnavian, while noting that former police chief Idham Azis was not among those present. This meeting follows recent public activity for General Suyudi, who was awarded for his work in community-centered policing reform earlier in the week. The assembly was characterized by local outlets as an official exchange of views on the current state of national affairs.
whyItIsViral: The story reached a high viral activity score due to rapid coverage across multiple national news outlets within a short timeframe.
